summary: Preserve computed names of class instance methods/accessors, evaluating the key during class definition and defining it on the prototype object.

target.notes: Evaluate and ToPropertyKey-convert the method key at class definition time, then define the method function on the runtime prototype with class-method descriptor attributes.

caveats: A fixed C# method name cannot preserve arbitrary computed property keys.

tests.name: computed method key once
tests.input: let n=0; const k=()=>`m${++n}`; class C { [k()](){return 1;} } console.log(n,new C().m1());

tests.name: edge: Symbol method
tests.input: const s=Symbol(); class C { [s](){return 9;} } console.log(new C()[s]());
